subject: si
title: SG.------HI.P.
description: Diagram in CMBA-4, paired with v1-p248-1. (C)SI (source initiation, conceptually) is crossed with HI-P (high purpose). The diagram poses what source initiation requires of high purpose to actually function — situated against Braxton's claim that black creativity's source-initiation 'completely solidify[ed] its own methodology' through 'natural continuance of affinity dynamics.' SI fans into three primary branches: HI-P (the crossing), INT (intention), and COS-P (cosmic particulars). INT → SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) → BIA (bi-aitional), which branches to EXT-FT (extended functionalism) and C-ACT (composite activism). COS-P branches to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) → a second BIA, and to DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) → a second INT.
